capabilities.responsibility: Space, Directory, Source ACL enable, detach, resume and disable

cases.operation: disabled -> inherited -> independent -> inherited -> disabled
cases.observable: Each legal transition changes the returned state and permission revision; refresh reads the persisted state.
cases.storage: ACL entries, snapshot, resource state and audit converge in one transaction.

cases.operation: Update and resume ACL for Space and Directory
cases.observable: Override returns independent state and entries; resume returns inherited state and removes local entries.
cases.storage: Resource permissionRevision increments and audit records the transition.

cases.operation: Illegal transition, stale permission revision and disabled Source ACL edit
cases.observable: Knowledge conflict or validation error; no partial state is written.
cases.storage: ACL and collaborator rows do not change on rejection.

cases.operation: Read, edit, resume or transfer a resource from another workspace
cases.observable: Stable not-found or forbidden response without parent, name or existence leakage.
cases.storage: No cross-workspace ACL write.

cases.operation: Persist legal ACL transitions and inspect canonical collections
cases.observable: The refreshed ACL summary agrees with persisted entries and revision.
cases.storage: knowledge_resource_permissions, permissionRevision, snapshotVersion and audit change consistently.

cases.operation: Concurrent ACL updates, detach, resume and disable using one revision
cases.observable: Exactly one mutation succeeds; all stale writers receive conflict.
cases.storage: One explainable final revision without interleaved ACL entries.

cases.operation: Inject audit failure inside an ACL transaction and repeat resume
cases.observable: The failed transaction rolls back; repeated resume is idempotent.
cases.storage: No orphan ACL or duplicate audit and an explainable snapshot outcome.

cases.operation: Open Source permission configuration and exercise state actions
cases.observable: Manage users can enable, detach, resume and disable; loading, failure and refreshed summaries are visible.
cases.storage: UI refresh reflects ACL revision and state.

cases.operation: Open the management surface as Viewer or Non-member
cases.observable: No editable management entry or submit control is available.
cases.storage: No mutation request is sent.

cases.operation: Owner, manage, write, read and non-member actions across Space, Directory and Source
cases.observable: The strongest effective role controls read, write, manage, delete and ownership actions.
cases.storage: Effective role is derived from the current parent snapshot and local override.

cases.operation: Nested inherited Source under a parent Directory override
cases.observable: The Source receives the nearest ancestor override.
cases.storage: Effective ACL reads the nearest materialized ancestor.

cases.operation: Unknown role, stale inheritance revision, owner self-demotion and duplicate collaborator
cases.observable: Validation or conflict error with no silent overwrite.
cases.storage: No partial ACL or collaborator row.

cases.operation: Child resource attempts to bypass parent or workspace denial
cases.observable: Final permission remains denied and resource existence is not leaked.
cases.storage: No denied-request ACL mutation.

cases.operation: Change collaborator role and inspect audit and revision
cases.observable: Role changes after refresh and old role no longer authorizes.
cases.storage: ACL entry, collaborator row, permissionRevision and audit agree.

cases.operation: Concurrent role changes and child writes during inheritance changes
cases.observable: Only a request with the current revision succeeds.
cases.storage: Final ACL revision explains all accepted changes.

cases.operation: Fail ACL audit write and replay permission side effects
cases.observable: No success is returned before the ACL transaction commits.
cases.storage: No duplicate audit or permission event.

cases.operation: Exhaust role by action and inspect repository query scoping
cases.observable: No role is sampled as a substitute for the full matrix.
cases.storage: Queries include workspaceId and conflict errors are stable.

cases.operation: Render operations as Viewer and as non-member
cases.observable: Create, edit, manage, delete and ownership entries are absent or disabled.
cases.storage: No unauthorized UI request.

capabilities.responsibility: Creator, Workspace Owner, collaborator and ownership transfer

cases.operation: Create a Space then transfer ownership to an active qualified collaborator
cases.observable: Creator is initial owner; target becomes the only owner after refresh.
cases.storage: ownershipMemberId, owner ACL, collaborator state and audit converge.

cases.operation: Self-transfer, read-only or revoked target, stale revision and duplicate request
cases.observable: Invalid target and stale request are rejected without changing the owner.
cases.storage: Failure rolls back the entire transfer.

cases.operation: Non-owner transfer and cross-workspace target ID
cases.observable: Transfer is denied and target membership details are not disclosed.
cases.storage: No ownership or ACL mutation.

cases.operation: Transfer a resource and inspect all required owner facts
cases.observable: Exactly one active owner exists.
cases.storage: Resource owner, old/new owner ACL, affected descendants and audit are consistent.

cases.operation: Concurrent transfer versus transfer or ACL update at one version
cases.observable: Exactly one request succeeds and stale requests return conflict.
cases.storage: No second owner or unexplainable revision.

cases.operation: Replay transfer-related side effects after delivery failure
cases.observable: Retry is safe and does not create a second owner.
cases.storage: One owner ACL and one logical ownership audit.

cases.operation: Open current owner, choose target, confirm and refresh
cases.observable: Owner change succeeds with loading, visible failure recovery and refreshed menus.
cases.storage: The UI summary reads the new owner and ACL after refresh.

unresolved.behavior: Organization and group collaborator eligibility for ownership transfer
unresolved.reason: The local FastGPT UI exposes org/group collaborator entries, but ownership transfer handlers are Pro-only and absent from the frozen local source.

unresolved.behavior: Resume inheritance from a root resource with no parent
unresolved.reason: The user requires rejection when no inheritance relationship exists; the local FastGPT test explicitly allows root dataset resume.
unresolved.decision: Follow the current user security decision and require rejection when there is no inheritable parent.
